title: Detect divergence in generated Anth.us articles
description:
# Detect divergence in generated Anth.us articles

## Intent

As an Anth.us maintainer, I want CI to detect manual edits to pod-generated articles, so that the pod remains the unambiguous source of truth without governing existing hand-authored posts.

## Behavior specification

Feature: Verify generated Anth.us content

Scenario: Generated content matches the pod
  Given an Anth.us article carries the pod-generated marker
  And regeneration matches the committed CMS file
  When the divergence check runs
  Then the check passes

Scenario: Generated content was edited in the CMS repository
  Given an Anth.us article carries the pod-generated marker
  And the committed CMS file differs from regeneration
  When the divergence check runs
  Then the check fails
  And the output identifies the divergent article and regeneration action

Scenario: Existing hand-authored content is inspected
  Given an Anth.us article does not carry the pod-generated marker
  When the divergence check runs
  Then that article is outside the pod divergence contract
  And the check does not require a pod source for it.
